Source: https://github.com/duerrsimon/bioicons (BioIcons library, cloned 2026-11-13, shallow).
- Files under `cc-by-3.0/`: Servier Medical Art, CC-BY 3.0 — attribution REQUIRED.
  Credit line: "Organ illustrations: Servier Medical Art, https://smart.servier.com, CC-BY 3.0".
- Files under `cc-0/`: CC0 1.0 public domain — no attribution required.
  - Human_heart.svg: Mariana Ruiz Villareal (Wikimedia), CC0.
  - healthy/fibrotic/cirrhotic_liver.svg: Jan Clusmann via BioIcons, CC0.
Transformations: stripped xml decl, comments, metadata/title/desc, editor namespaces; whitespace collapsed.
Motion Studio artifacts using this library must display the Servier credit line in their footer.
